references.phrase: smallest subfield containing F and alpha
references.context: Field theory: subfield generated by adjoining one extension element α to a base field F

references.disposition: An element of the ambient extension field, not the distinct terminology of a primitive root of unity or a primitive root of a finite group.

review_rationale: Read the complete primitive-element definition; the extension and finite-degree requirements have existing independent contextual meanings. The construction F(α), the smallest subfield generated by F and α, remains unassigned instead of confusing this notion with a primitive root of unity.
